AIMIM Leader Stabbed to Death in Hyderabad; Police Investigate

AIMIM leader Mahboob Ali was stabbed to death on August 30 in Vattepally, Hyderabad. He was the AIMIM's area president. Police have formed three teams to trace the gang responsible for the stabbing. Six individuals are reportedly involved in the incident.
